DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 21 s. 2022 APR 18 2022 HON. RUBIO J. SINDON Punong Barangay Barangay Pulot, Municipality of Lagayan Province of Abra Dear Hon. Sindon: This pertains to your letter dated 19 February 2021 requesting for the Department's opinion concerning your complaint against Mayor Edmark Crisologo, OIC Punong Barangay Arnel Velasquez and Landbank Manager Gina Gabuat. Said letter did not, however, specify what specific queries are being submitted for this Department's opinion. It merely referred to a couple of documents attached thereto but nowhere in these documents stated or enumerated queries upon which the Department may provide an opinion. Also, the Department cannot evaluate the attached documents and merely decipher on its own the possible issue that may be given an opinion. The documents, however, showed that there is an administrative case against you before the Sangguniang Bayan of Lagayan, Abra, docketed as Admin Case No. 02- 2020 for an alleged violation of Section 60, Paragraphs c and f of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code". One of the attached documents, a Sanggunian Bayan Order/Resolution, showed that the Sanggunian declared among others that there exist a prima facie case against him and that a 60- day preventive suspension was imposed. Relative to this, we can generally advise that with respect to that administrative case and/proceedings as well as any other issues relevant thereto, the Department shall not give any opinion following the sub judice rule. Under the said rule, the Department is proscribed from rendering opinion in cases pending before other tribunals so as not to influence said body of its opinion and in order to help maintain the impartiality of the latter. Incidentally, we ought to discuss that the decision of the sangguniang panlungsod or bayan in an administrative case filed against any elective barangay official is final and executory. Section 61 (c) of R.A. No. 7160 provides as follows: "A complaint against any elective barangay official shall be filed before the sangguniang panlungsod or sangguniang bayan concemed whose decision shall be final and executory. " "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

Insofar as preventive suspension is concemed, Section 63 (b) authorized its imposition as follows: "(b) Preventive suspension may be imposed at any time after the issues are joined, when the evidence of guilt is strong, and given the gravity of the offense, there is great probability that the continuance in office of the respondent could influence the witnesses or pose a threat to the safety and integrity of the records and other evidence: Provided, That, any single preventive suspension of local elective officials shall not extend beyond sixty (60) days: Provided, further, That in the event that several administrative cases are filed against an elective official, he cannot be preventively suspended for more than ninety (90) days within a single year on the same ground or grounds existing and known at the time of the first suspension. " Instead of requesting for a favorable opinion from the Department on any relevant issue, the remedy of herein respondent against unfavorable decision is to file an appeal before the sangguniang panlalawigan pursuant to Section 67 (a) of the Local Government Code, viz: "SECTION 67. Administrative Appeals. — Decisions in administrative cases may, within thirty (30) days from receipt thereof, be appealed to the following: xxx The sangguniang panlalawigan, in the case of decisions of the sangguniang panlungsod of component cities and the sangguniang bayan;" This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very rs, Y AUTHORITY OF THE S MA IN B. DINO RETARY: dersecretary for Barangay Affairs LLLS/RPB/LRALLD/kbm Copy fumished DIR. ARACELI A.
